bio: Since August 2026 I’ve been studying Communication Design HF, specialising in Interaction Design. The three-year programme runs until August 2029.
At the Schule für Gestaltung Zürich, my first semester includes web technologies, experimental storytelling, game design and design thinking. In the LAB, I work on my own concepts.
I’m also doing the Google UX Design Certificate. In my projects, research comes first, then iteration. I only work on the visual details once the behaviour is right.
Before I moved into UX design, I trained in accounting. That’s where my sense for clear structures and careful work comes from.
